title: Explicit interpolations among the Sierpiński, Rauzy, and Apollonian gaskets
summary: We study two explicit one-parameter families organized around the affine Sierpiński gasket. The first is an affine-projective interpolation from the Sierpiński gasket to the Rauzy gasket: the first-level hole is fixed throughout the family, the symbolic quotient remains the classical Sierpiński quotient, the associated three-dimensional stack is homeomorphic to $S\times[0,1]$, and the constant-address cells display a transition from uniform contraction to the non-uniform projective scaling of the Rauzy endpoint.
